## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## 💡 Motivation & Use Case
Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve for developers or DevOps engineers?

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Implementation Ideas
How do you envision this working? (e.g. changes in `src-tauri/src/docker.rs`, new UI tab in React, new Tauri IPC command, etc.)

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or diagrams about the feature request here.
